goal: Return error status directly from validation and storage routines rather than triggering node shutdowns
Lets libbitcoinkernel callers handle fatal errors programmatically instead of via global callbacks
agreement: Unaddressed objection: Result-style error handling hurts performance and defies C++ idioms (purpleKarrot)
Concern about fragile nested result unwrapping and missed interruptions was answered (maflcko)
Inconsistency from ignored flush returns mutating validation state was resolved in #35621 (optout21)
Approval without stated reason from an account with no project history (Graysonbarton)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it allows library consumers to receive structured error information directly at call sites
Removing node-specific abort assumptions is required to make validation usable as a standalone library

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it broadens utility result primitives to support detailed status codes and flush outcomes
The primary motivation is decoupling the kernel rather than providing standalone utility benefits
